description: 2048, in 8BitScript, from one source file, on the VIC-20, C64, PET, C128, Atari 8-bit, NES, Commander X16, MEGA65, and the web.

scripts.build:web: 8bs build --target web --hardware machine=c64 && 8bs build --target web --hardware machine=pet-2001 && 8bs build --target web --hardware machine=vic20 && 8bs build --target web && cp site/index.html dist/web/index.html
scripts.check: 8bs check src/2048.8bs src/lib/draw/font.8bs src/lib/draw/palette.8bs src/lib/draw/tile.8bs src/lib/game/rules.8bs src/lib/host/host.8bs src/lib/layout/layout.8bs src/lib/raster/wobble.8bs src/lib/text/strings.8bs src/lib/text/version.8bs src/ui/Game.8bx src/ui/board/Board.8bx src/ui/board/GameOver.8bx src/ui/board/ScoreBar.8bx src/ui/board/Tile.8bx src/ui/board/Tiles.8bx src/ui/title/Copyright.8bx src/ui/title/Logo.8bx src/ui/title/StartMessage.8bx src/ui/title/TitleScreen.8bx src/ui/title/TitleWobble.8bx src/ui/title/Version.8bx
